property_summary: For every admissible input, after settle() a guesser is paid 2 ether only if his locked hash equals keccak256(blockhash(target block)) (P); the mutant pays whenever the hash equals the raw blockhash (e.g. 0 when the block is out of range), breaking the rule.
change_summary: Use the raw blockhash directly as the answer instead of its keccak256 hash, changing which guesses win.
